albums.name: Portraits
albums.description: Raw and honest capture of the beauty of the human condition.

albums.name: Street
albums.description: Little moments from the markets, laneways and footpaths.

photos.title: Not today
photos.caption: Not everyone wants their photo taken, and that is a moment worth keeping too.

photos.title: Clock tower
photos.caption: Old red brick peeking out from behind the trees.

photos.title: This way
photos.caption: A country street corner with everything you need: a postbox, a sign and a big blue sky.

photos.title: Golden hour
photos.caption: Last light over the long grass as the new houses go quiet for the evening.

photos.title: Closed for the season
photos.caption: An empty packing shed under a heavy sky. You can almost hear the trucks that used to roll through.

photos.title: Lines
photos.caption: A lone power pole holding the whole street together.

photos.title: Cracked
photos.caption: Years of summers and heavy trucks, written into the road.

photos.title: This gate
photos.caption: An old fruit packing shed, its painted sign still giving directions to nobody in particular.

photos.title: Walkies
photos.caption: The happiest one at the market, and he knows it.

photos.title: Bee in the midst of lavender
photos.caption: A busy bee doing the rounds through the lavender.

photos.title: Spring
photos.caption: New leaves catching the sun between the power lines.

photos.title: Ink
photos.caption: Stories on his arms, somewhere to be.

photos.title: The weekly shop
photos.caption: Trolley loaded, a routine she has probably done a thousand times.

photos.title: Waiting
photos.caption: A quiet seat in a laneway full of fairy lights and passing footsteps.

photos.title: Smoke break
photos.caption: A quick break in front of a mural much louder than he is.

photos.title: Queen Vic
photos.caption: Weathered paint on a market bollard. Still standing after all the crowds.

photos.title: Bolts of colour
photos.caption: Rolls of printed fabric lined up like a rainbow waiting to be sewn into something.
